# Supply per-branch messages without prompting, reading files only for new CRs.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T18:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git add .shamhub
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add one.txt
gs branch create feature1 -m 'Default title one' -m 'Default body one'
git add two.txt
gs branch create feature2 -m 'Default title two' -m 'Default body two'
git add three.txt
gs branch create feature3 -m 'Default title three'

# A title-only file supplies an empty body, even with --fill and a CR template.
gs --no-prompt downstack submit --branch feature1 --no-draft --fill --message-file feature1:$WORK/messages/one.md
stderr 'Created #1'

# Mixed submission uses file content for feature3 and commit defaults for feature2.
gs --no-prompt upstack submit --branch feature2 --draft --fill --message-file feature3:$WORK/messages/three.md
stderr 'Created #2'
stderr 'Created #3'

# Dry runs and push-only submissions do not consume message files.
git add four.txt
gs branch create feature4 -m 'Default title four'
gs --no-prompt stack submit --dry-run --no-draft --message-file feature4:$WORK/messages/empty.md
stderr 'WOULD create a CR for feature4'
gs --no-prompt stack submit --no-publish --no-draft --message-file feature4:$WORK/messages/empty.md
stderr 'Pushed'

# Stack submission reads the remaining new CR's file.
gs --no-prompt stack submit --no-draft --message-file feature4:$WORK/messages/four.md
stderr 'Created #4'
shamhub dump changes
cmpenvJSON stdout $WORK/golden/changes.json

-- repo/one.txt --
one
-- repo/two.txt --
two
-- repo/three.txt --
three
-- repo/four.txt --
four
-- repo/.shamhub/CHANGE_TEMPLATE.md --
Default template body
-- messages/empty.md --

-- messages/one.md --
Custom title one
-- messages/three.md --
Custom title three
-- messages/four.md --
Custom title four

Body four.
